summary: Strong test suite with comprehensive coverage of core secret-rotation functionality: urgency classification, config parsing, report generation, and output formatting all well-tested. Boundary testing is thorough (exact expiry dates, window edges, calendar-impossible dates). Error scenarios extensively covered (malformed JSON, invalid dates, duplicate names, missing files, invalid CLI args). Well-organized by module with clear test names and readable assertions. Excellent integration testing via act harness (scripts/run-act-tests.ts) validates the full pipeline. Exact-string assertions on output (markdown tables, JSON summaries) are critical for CI. Fixture builders (secret() function, SECRETS constant) keep tests DRY. Minor gaps: missing tests for special characters/unicode in values, very large datasets, file permissions, negative window values. The test.skipIf() for actionlint could hide validation errors on machines without the binary. Would reliably catch regressions in core logic and output format changes.
